t: A Python engine written in JavaScript that runs inside the browser.
steps: Pick a host such as Trinket that uses Skulpt.
Copy the iframe embed code into a lesson page.
Test a short turtle graphics program.
For self-hosting, download the skulpt-dist zip.
Load skulpt.js and skulpt-stdlib.js in a page.
Note that no CDN link is offered on the using page.
Remember that NumPy is unsupported and the debugger is very limited.
